promotions.condition_description: Deposit the minimum amount into your Chase Business Complete Checking account within 30 days of offer enrollment and maintain that balance for 60 days from offer enrollment. Complete 5 qualifying transactions* within 90 days of offer enrollment. Your bonus will be deposited within 15 days.

Deposit at least $2,000 in new money (not existing deposits at Chase or affiliates) within 30 days of offer enrollment and maintain that balance for 60 days from offer enrollment; if the balance falls below the minimum at any time during the 60 days, the bonus may be reduced or no longer qualify. Complete 5 qualifying transactions within 90 days of offer enrollment (debit card purchases, Chase QuickDeposit, ACH credits, wire credits/debits, Chase Online Bill Pay, Chase QuickAccept; ACH debits, Zelle and other person-to-person payments, and transfers to Chase credit cards are excluded). Bonus is deposited within 15 days after all requirements are met; the account must be open and unrestricted at payout. Not available to existing Chase business checking customers; signers can receive one business checking offer every two years. Reported as interest on IRS Form 1099-INT.

promotions.condition_description: Apply for and open an Innovator Business Checking account with promo code NW300 between July 1, 2026 and November 30, 2026. Within 30 days of account opening, deposit at least $10,000 in new money (transfers from other Grasshopper accounts do not count). Maintain an average daily balance of at least $10,000 from day 31 through day 90 after account opening. Bonus is deposited into the Innovator Business Checking account by the 15th of the month after the maintenance period ends, provided the account is not closed or locked. New clients only (not an owner or authorized signer on any Grasshopper account in the past 12 months); must be 18+ and a legal resident of the 50 states or DC; U.S. citizens with a valid Form W-9 on file and not subject to backup withholding; one bonus per business owner or authorized signer, no stacking. Grasshopper employees and their immediate family or household members are not eligible. Grasshopper may reverse the bonus if the account is closed within 150 days of opening. Reported as interest on IRS Form 1099-INT.

plan_tiers.apy_condition: Spend $500/month on Bluevine Business Debit Mastercard OR receive $2,500/month in deposits to checking or sub-accounts

plan_tiers.monthly_fee_waiver_condition: Waived each billing period by maintaining an average daily balance of at least $20,000 in Bluevine Business Checking and/or sub-accounts AND spending at least $2,000 on the Bluevine Business Debit Mastercard or Bluevine Business Cashback Mastercard.

Waived each billing period by maintaining an average daily balance of at least $100,000 in Bluevine Business Checking and/or sub-accounts AND spending at least $5,000 on the Bluevine Business Debit Mastercard.

general_features.description: No overdraft fees: Found does not charge overdraft fees or insufficient funds fees. When the account balance is insufficient to cover a transaction, the transaction is declined. Accounts with a negative balance for 30 or more consecutive days may be closed.

Optional interest-bearing subscriptions: the base Found Business Checking account earns no interest. Found Plus subscribers ($35/month or $315/year) earn 1.50% APY on balances up to $20,000. Found Pro subscribers ($80/month or $720/year) earn 2.50% APY on all balances with no balance cap. Subscriptions auto-renew and can be canceled at any time from app settings.

Pockets (virtual sub-accounts): create multiple named sub-accounts within a single Found account to organize and earmark funds. Default Pockets (Primary and Tax) are provided automatically. Each Pocket receives its own unique routing number for direct ACH deposits and can have a virtual card assigned for card spending. Custom Pockets can be added, renamed, and deactivated at any time.

ATM access: Found does not charge fees for ATM withdrawals. ATM operator and network surcharges may be imposed by the ATM owner and are not controlled or reimbursed by Found. Daily ATM cash withdrawal limit: $550. Card works at any ATM displaying Mastercard, Interlink, Maestro, or Cirrus acceptance marks.
Digital wallet support: the Found Mastercard Business Debit Card can be added to Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay, and other digital wallets at no additional charge from Found.

Found Mastercard Business Debit Card: up to 10 physical cards per account, accepted everywhere Mastercard debit cards are accepted. Issued by Lead Bank pursuant to a license from Mastercard Inc. Supports chip, PIN, contactless, and digital wallet transactions.

Virtual debit cards: up to 20 virtual cards per account. Each virtual card can be assigned to a specific Pocket (sub-account) and shared with team members. Virtual cards support card-not-present transactions wherever Mastercard is accepted and can be locked instantly via the mobile app.
Cash deposits: you can deposit up to $2,000 per rolling 7 days.
Cash deposits: you can deposit up to $4,000 per rolling 30 days.
Maximum deposit amounts may be limited by the merchant.
The minimum cash deposit size must be $5.

Real-time card controls: lock and unlock any physical or virtual card instantly via the mobile app. Per-card spending limits can be set for individual cards issued to team members. Real-time push notifications for transactions.

Security features include two-factor authentication (2FA), data encryption, secure infrastructure, and comprehensive fraud monitoring. Customer support is available via live chat and email at help@found.com.

Full-service mobile app (iOS and Android) and web portal: manage accounts, view real-time transaction history, send payments, manage cards, set per-card spending limits, lock and unlock cards instantly, and receive real-time transaction notifications from any device. No branch visits required.

Mobile check deposit: deposit checks by photographing the front and back using the Found mobile app. Funds are ordinarily available within 5 business days. Check deposit cutoff time: 3:00 PM ET for same-day processing.

ACH transfers and direct deposit: free to send and receive with no per-transaction fee. Standard ACH transfers initiated through the mobile app may take up to 5 business days. Direct deposit is accepted via ACH.

Express transfers to external bank accounts: same-day or next-business-day ACH transfers from Found to a linked external bank account. Fee: 1% of the transfer amount, capped at $25.00 with a minimum fee of $0.50.

Instant Payments via FedNow: near-real-time payments sent and received through the FedNow Service operated by the Federal Reserve. Outgoing fee: the greater of 1.75% of the payment amount or $0.50. Receiving Instant Payments is free. Instant Payments are irrevocable once submitted and cannot be canceled, reversed, or amended.

Outgoing check payments: send paper checks via the Found mobile app. Fee: $1.00 per outgoing check, refundable if canceled within 30 minutes of submission. Found Pro subscribers ($80/month or $720/year) send checks at no charge.

Outgoing wire transfers: available as an optional service. Standard accounts pay $15 per outgoing wire. Found Pro subscribers pay $10 per outgoing wire. The fee is refunded if the wire is canceled or rejected; it is otherwise nonrefundable including if the wire is returned. Note international wires are not supported.

Automated bookkeeping and expense tracking: real-time expense categorization and financial insights built into the Found platform. View spending by category and track business finances without leaving the app.

Built-in invoicing: create, send, and track invoices directly within Found. Accept invoice payments via Stripe. Stripe processing fees (charged by Stripe, not Found): 2.9% + $0.30 for card payments; $1.50 per link + 0.8% per transfer for direct debit; 3.1% + $0.30 for Cash App Pay. Tap to Pay for in-person contactless payments via Stripe: 2.7% + $0.05 + $0.10 per tap.
Contractor management: collect W-9 information from independent contractors and generate 1099 forms for contractors paid through the Found account. Supports 1099 delivery to contractors.

Found Pro dedicated account manager: Found Pro subscribers ($80/month or $720/year) receive access to a dedicated account manager for personalized support and faster response times. Found Pro also includes 1% cash back on qualifying card purchases.
Quickly integrate with QuickBooks, Stripe, Cash App, PayPal, Square, Lyft, Uber, Venmo, Etsy, eBay, and more.

Tax tools for the self-employed: automatic tracking and estimation of self-employment tax obligations. Found helps estimate quarterly self-employment tax payments and can facilitate direct payment to the IRS using account funds.

These are adjacent lending products, not features of the checking account itself.

Every Lili plan, including the free Core plan, includes access to a linked Lili Savings account with a variable, tiered APY: 2.25% APY on balances up to and including $500,000, and 4.00% APY on the portion of the balance from $500,000 up to and including $1,000,000. There is no minimum balance requirement and no lockup period; interest accrues daily from the first dollar. This savings account is a separate linked product from the checking account and is not itself part of this checking listing's interest fields.

No overdraft fees or non-sufficient funds fees are charged on any plan. Transactions that would overdraw the account are generally declined rather than processed with a fee, unless the account holder is enrolled in BalanceUp (Pro, Smart, and Premium plans only — see plan-scoped feature rows below).

Fee-free debit card withdrawals at 40,000+ in-network MoneyPass ATMs nationwide. Out-of-network (non-MoneyPass) domestic ATM transactions cost $2.50; international ATM transactions cost $5.00 and international balance inquiries cost $2.50. The ATM owner may charge an additional surcharge on top of Lili's fee.

Lili Visa® Debit Card, issued as a digital card instantly upon signup with a physical card to follow, available to the primary account owner and each ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) with full account access. No foreign transaction fee is charged on debit card purchases made outside the U.S.

Lili does not charge a fee for cash deposits made at participating retail locations (90,000+ including Walmart, CVS, Walgreens and 7-Eleven). The retail partner may charge its own service fee at the register, typically up to $4.95 per transaction depending on the location; that fee is set by the retailer, not Lili, and is not a Lili fee. Cash deposit limits vary by retailer.
Reported by third-party coverage, not stated on a Lili page: cash deposits are capped at $1,500 per day and $5,000 per month. Lili's own help article says: "Cash deposit limits vary by retailer."
Live customer support available 7 days a week, plus 24/7 automated smart assistance.
